intro: A Schengen country with a one-year Digital Nomad Visa and income-tax exemption for DNV residents. A long Adriatic coastline and access to the entire EU.
climate: Mediterranean along the coast, continental in Zagreb. Warm dry summers around +28°C, mild winters by the sea around +10°C.
mentality: Balkan hospitality combined with Central European discipline. A strong regional identity across Dalmatia, Istria and Zagorje.
language_note: Croatian is the official language, a Slavic language that is partly understood by Russian speakers. English is used in tourism and IT.
visa_note: Schengen visa or residence permit. The DNV is for remote workers with an income from 2,870 euros per month — a one-year residence permit with no option to renew.
